summary: 14-year-old boy fell into the Poudre River while fishing near Ouzel Campground; his 38-year-old uncle jumped in to rescue him; both Greeley residents drowned. Bystanders pulled the unconscious uncle out ~2 miles downstream and performed CPR without success; he died later in a local hospital. The boy's body was found by a rafter/kayaker ~8 miles downstream ~3 hours after the search began; the coroner conducted autopsies.
responding_agency: Larimer County Sheriff's Office, Larimer County Search and Rescue, Larimer County Dive Rescue Team
notes: Incident date recorded as Memorial Day 2014 (Memorial Day was Monday 2014-05-26); year pinned from the article's search-index "last updated" metadata (~2014-05-27, consistent with a post-Memorial-Day publication).
